name: Flattrade
description: Flattrade is an Indian discount stockbroker that offers a free API (Pi) for trading on NSE, BSE, NFO and MCX. With this integration you can search instruments, fetch live quotes and historical candle data, place and cancel orders, and check your order book and positions. The MA Crossover Signal trigger watches an instrument's moving averages and fires a BUY when the fast average (default 7) crosses above the slow one (default 18) and a SELL when it crosses back, so you can automate indicator-based trades.
